note: Dollars per cell for projections. A (model, arm, family) cell projects from measured Hard cells when they exist (eval/runner/cat40/hard-ops.ts --measured), otherwise from the measured v1 cost per cell of that model and arm (v1_per_cell_usd) times the Hard factor for its arm and family, plus the measured judge cost for its family. memory borrows the fs factors and gbrain the pg factors.

sources.claude-fable-5-1: entity-recall/holdout/simple-arms-new-models/results.jsonl (fs, pg, oracle); entity-recall/holdout/wave (gbrain); memory = Opus 5.5 memory x 2.5 (list price ratio, unmeasured)

hard_factor_source: Calibration round 1 (2026-10-05, seed 20261005, knobs.round-1.json, Sonnet 5.5 and GPT-6 Astra, 189 of 300 cells, $35.18): measured cost per cell over v1 cost per cell, averaged over cells. H1 to H3 have 20 cells per arm; H4 has 2 to 4 (fs H4 uses the H3 factor because its 2-cell measurement, 0.44, is below every other family); H5 is unmeasured and assumed 3 x the H2-H4 mean (five sessions, four of them short). Round 2 replaces these with its own measurements.
judge_source: Measured gpt-6.1-sol judge dollars per cell in calibration round 1 (H5 assumed equal to H4).

slot_build.note: v1-large (52,028 docs) slot builds cost $1.177 each (scale-tier receipt); a Hard slot build is projected as 1.177 x world bytes / 41,551,224.
